log.notes: FC pale pink in the 3–5 'POOL OK' band (recorded 4). pH pegged at top square (recorded 8.4, real >8.4). TA dark olive matching 180–240 (recorded 210).

advice.text: Swim OK: FC is in the 3–5 band. Keep it 2–4 from now on; chlorinate only with 3% bleach (no more dichlor/trichlor — CYA ≈ 39 ppm already).
TA 180–240 is the real problem: it buffers pH, which is why 250 g barely moved it. Correct TA first — add 300 g dry acid dissolved in a bucket, pump running. Retest tomorrow.
Repeat 300 g dry acid steps until TA ≈ 100–120 (~700 g total, 3–4 rounds over a week). Don't do it in one hit.
After each acid dose, aim the return jet upward to churn the surface — aeration pushes pH up while TA stays down, so pH won't crash below 7.
White surface dust is calcium precipitate from pH >8.4 — it stops as pH comes down; brush and let the filter catch it.
Weekly maintenance: ~50 ml CTX-500 algaecide; rinse the cartridge; test FC + pH.
